items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: She played in my band with me. One of them bands, I don't know if it wasn't Enola or the, or the Silver Leaf or one of them.

ctx.x: Camilla Todd, Mercedes, Homer Fields? Well, I worked with her too, I worked with her as a silver lead orchestra. Oh.
Mercedes, Homer Fields? No, she wasn't in that band. She wasn't in that band. No, she wasn't in that band.
She wasn't in that band. I see. It was May who used to play with Sam Morgan. No, not at all.
